title: Understanding profit and loss in food delivery
summary: A confidential analysis of customer, vendor and order data focused on unit economics and possible operational changes.
businessQuestion: How do customer, vendor and order patterns relate to profit and loss, and which practical adjustments merit testing?
source: Confidential live-platform customer, vendor and order records. Public details are limited to information approved for release.

title: Customer segments in public retail data
summary: An exploration of transaction data using recency, frequency and monetary value, with clustering considered for segment comparisons.
businessQuestion: How can customers be grouped by recency, frequency and monetary value to support distinct retention decisions?
source: UCI Machine Learning Repository, Online Retail dataset. https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/352/online+retail

title: Understanding responses to a direct marketing campaign
summary: An exploration of customer response patterns in a public direct-marketing dataset. It has no spend or revenue fields, so ROI is not assessed.
businessQuestion: How do customer and contact characteristics relate to response in the public direct-marketing dataset?
source: UCI Machine Learning Repository, Bank Marketing dataset. https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/222/bank+marketing

title: A Nigeria market view from public indicators
summary: A market-research study of Nigeria's GDP indicator, with the measure and period stated alongside the source.
businessQuestion: How has Nigeria's GDP (current US$) changed across the selected period, and what context should accompany that comparison?
